subject.title: fix(security): bound plugin manifest reads in audit deep scan

question: Should deep security audit enforce a 1 MiB ceiling for installed plugin `package.json` reads?
rationale: The bounded-read mechanism is correct and well proven, but neither current OpenClaw discovery code nor `@openclaw/fs-safe` establishes this exact threshold, so selecting the resource-versus-compatibility boundary requires owner intent.

options.title: Approve 1 MiB
options.body: Adopt the strict audit-specific ceiling and land the current focused implementation.

options.title: Choose Another Ceiling
options.body: Adjust the maximum and refresh the regression test and real CLI proof before merge.

recommendation.title: Approve 1 MiB
recommendation.body: Adopt the strict audit-specific ceiling and land the current focused implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: This team is the explicit CODEOWNER for the changed security-audit path and the most appropriate decision owner for its resource boundary.
